answer: Randomness-Gated Join Window: each epoch, agents submit registration intents into a pool; a verifiable random beacon (threshold BLS, unbiasable) then selects a random subset and random ordering, so entry slots cannot be targeted or precomputed. Every accepted identity must harbor a distinct proof-of-work derived from that epoch's beacon output, binding registration to unpredictable data.
